parts:

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Do I really need vim > 7.4.1722
parts: Vim on terminal is OK, but GVim < 1722 crashes after starting R on Linux, and the bug was fixed by patch 1722.

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Do I really need vim > 7.4.1722
parts: The correct information is: Vim on terminal does not crash, but it is not OK, because the nclientserver is killed by Vim during garbage collection and, consequently, not everything in the plugin works.
